text.p: Century Communications Corp said on Tuesday it completed $875 million in long-term financing facilities with a syndicate of banks led by Citibank N.A..
Proceeds would be used to refinance existing debt and provide capital investment for Century's cable television systems, the company said in a statement.
The facility was a three-year, unsecured revolving loan, which would convert into a five-year term loan, it said.
The new loan provided for lower interest rates and greater financial flexibility, the company said.

"This financing is a key element in furthering the diversification and flexibility of our balance sheet," Century Senior Vice President and Treasurer Scott Schneider said in a statement. "We are pleased that this group of banks recognized and supported Century's commitment to the continued growth of its core cable television business."
The six managing agents were Bank of America, Chase Manhattan Bank, LTCB Trust Company, Societe Generale, Sumitomo Bank and Toronto Dominion Bank.
